cases.mechanism: In patch.py, _norm('39.2+10^{-7}') makes no useful change. _rational returns None. _arith also fails: _defrac turns the braces into '39.2+10^(-7)', and the '^' is not in the token regex, so the `''.join(toks) != s` check returns None. The fallback _near_miss only looks at the literals 39.2, 10 and 7. 39.2 equals the gold exactly, so `v != ag` is False, and 10 and 7 are far from it. No near miss is flagged, so tighten() returns the original reward. In the original grader, math_verify parses 39.2 + 10**(-7) as a Float, 39.2000001. sympy_numeric_eq rounds this to about 6 decimals, which gives 39.2, so it is accepted.
cases.why_incorrect: 39.2 + 10^{-7} = 39.2000001, which is not 39.2. The verifier compares exact values and marks it wrong.
